$comment: Hand overrides of body-region membership (M13 plan decision 4; SPEC-platform §6.2). Each entry: {id, region, reason}; the reason is one line. `npm run regions` applies them; validate-content checks that each names a real structure and fine region and changes something. BL's policy: bones only, where a region's box reaches a bone that anatomy places elsewhere; soft tissue keeps what its vertices say.
